cases.name: Initial Gotenks

cases.name: GT Gogeta

cases.name: Future Vegito

cases.name: Kefla

cases.name: Kibito Kai
cases.note: No Saiyan form. Below Buu despite being stronger than either constituent. Standalone constituent source gap: Kibito 50 Million is a declared campaign estimate, not a retrieved wiki reading.

events.name: Buu exact absorption ledger
events.note: Structural Buu bodies are separate endpoints. Captured active donors add once; expiry replaces Gotenks with the two children.

events.name: Baby composite progression
events.note: Separate estimated absorbed capacities; normal SS x50 and Golden x500 are alternatives. x2 effort is an accepted event reading; the shown donation grants the Full SS4 state. Majuub is retained narratively without an invented injury fraction.

events.name: Battle of Gods bridge
events.note: Retains selected wiki post-ritual ordinary 300 Billion, with prior base raised to follow the revised Buu history. Beerus value is an event output estimate, never his maximum. His early verbal Frieza appraisal is not treated as an exact rested reading.

events.name: Anime Zamasu
events.note: Corrupted Rose3 x8 Million is an accepted form release. Spirit Sword is ONE supplied attack using battle residue plus offered energy; not a Trunks body multiplier. Its calibrated output does not erase the immortal essence. Defusion remains duration/expenditure, not a proven Zamasu shatter technique.

events.name: Tournament of Power anime
events.note: Sign wins through evasive technique and a charged hit with a separately declared x1.5 final effort, within the user-authorised effort range. This is not body-power equality or an intrinsic Kamehameha multiplier change. Earlier Kale walking through a Blue attack does not measure full rested Blue output; no numerical suppression percentage is assigned. Final Jiren endpoint is a campaign estimate, not a fixed ratio established by footage.

events.name: Super Broly film stages
events.note: Entry to late ordinary capacity rises 100-fold across the depicted continuing growth and prolonged Frieza fight. Exact amount is an accepted benchmark, not a demonstrated Zenkai. Berserk Wrathful x400,000 and Full x160 Billion retain the selected page estimates; Berserk SS is corrected to x400,000 x50. These are distinct mutant forms, not standard Wrathful x10 or ordinary SS1.

events.name: Prison Planet adapted
events.note: REQUIRED SCENE ADAPTATIONS: after defusion Goku uses KK20 for ranged distraction/evasion until Fu destroys the moon, not a durable physical exchange with the ape. Fu can fight the individual Xeno pair at the assigned event output; cutting the moon is not overpowering the ape. The returning Cumber beam is intercepted by the still-fused Xeno Vegito, not physically held by the unfused group. Solo UI Goku can evade/stall but does not overpower Cumber; Xeno Vegito supplies the decisive counter before extraction. These deliberately rewrite the secondary anime sequence, rather than hiding enormous body-power gaps behind survival or regeneration.

events.name: Hearts, Dark King and Creation
events.note: All opponent endpoints are explicit campaign allocations tied to encounter margins. Body damage does not permanently kill Dark King; sealing remains necessary. Broly intermediate stages are enumerated; not every stage is claimed to be shown in this one anime episode. Manga-specific joint-fight details are not substituted for the anime overpowering sequence.

events.name: Crimson and Tree
events.note: Crimson has no new intrinsic Full Power multiplier: x2 effort, then an actual finite energy harvest calibrated as another x2. This fourfold event peak is an accepted campaign ruling, not a source measurement. To avoid a billionfold supply fabrication, the campaign changes Gogeta Blue/Evolution in this secondary duel to base/SS1. Tree quantities are separately declared external-source event estimates; none becomes Goku ordinary base.

events.name: Later Heroes and manga
events.note: Later standalone enemy endpoints are explicit campaign estimates. Manga Gohan equals Kefla for the mutual ring-out; this is not the anime Gohan. Later solo Vegeta comparison uses Controlled Berserk in the accepted adaptation, not a newly inflated Evolution factor.
